title: How a Godly Man Handles Anger Without Suppressing or Exploding
caption:
A godly man still gets angry. Anger isn't the sin. What you do with it is.

Name what it's guarding. Wait before you answer. Aim it at the wrong, not at the person. Close it before dark. Four small moves, and Scripture already handed them to us.

Who do you owe a quick apology to tonight?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #anger #selfcontrol #scripture
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
